name: Creator Arts Minor
intro: The Creator Arts minor within the School of Dramatic Arts prepares students to thrive in today’s rapidly evolving creator economy by uniting artistic practice with entrepreneurial strategy. Designed for students across disciplines, the minor equips undergraduates with the creative, strategic, and collaborative tools necessary to build sustainable, self-generated careers.
